posts.text:
Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was a husband, father, and hardworking member of his community who spent decades building a life for his family. He was shot and killed by an ICE officer on his way to work.

His family deserves transparency, accountability, and an independent investigation.
posts.summary: Demands transparency and investigation into ICE officer shooting

Frederick Douglass famously asked: what to a slave is July 4? Juneteenth is Black America's Independence Day.

Grateful to celebrate with neighbors, community organizations, and elected officials across the Bronx. We will keep working to make freedom real for all.
